text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
“—Up next, the phenomenon that has been 
spreading across the world since last 
year—”

text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
Here is news regarding the new infectious 
disease.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
“—At present, signs of domestic spread 
remain weak—”

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"—We must continue to closely monitor the 
situation overseas—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With Loves Only You finally entering her 
Senior year, talks about a certain 
infectious disease were becoming 
widespread in the public."

text_block_list.name: Hardworker@Overseas Assignment
text_block_list.text:
"Haaa, I'm really torn on whether I should 
head back from overseas once~. Hope this 
doesn't turn into a bigger mess."

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it's fine for now, and maybe it'll 
just settle down on its own? These things 
usually work out that way, right?"

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
"That said, everyone take care of your 
health~. Colds are pretty common around 
this time of year."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even within Loves Only You's community, 
talk about the infectious disease began 
popping up here and there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was bracing myself, knowing I 
needed to take proper care of my own 
health as well—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun, Happy New Year♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Trainer-chan, Happy New Year♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~ I'm here♪ Well? Were you surprised?
choice_data_list:
I thought we were supposed to have New 
Year's off...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
We did that last year too~! I'm on my 
off-day right now, that's why I came♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-kun, have you gone for 
Hatsumode yet?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-chan, have you gone for 
Hatsumode yet?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yay♪ Well then, let's go together♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, on short notice, I ended up going 
on a New Year's shrine visit with Loves 
Only You—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—I'm glad it was less crowded than I 
expected. Thanks to that, we've got plenty 
of free time♪
choice_data_list:
Well then, shall we head back to the 
academy?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. Are you being serious right now?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I absoluteee-ly refuse to go home like 
this!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
We're on a date today, so let's go have 
some fun just like this♪ Deal?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, geez. Trainer-kun, seriously, 
that's so like you. ...Well, that's what's 
great about you, though.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, geez. Trainer-chan, seriously, 
that's so like you. ...Well, that's what's 
great about you, though.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A-ny-way! Today is officially a date♪ 
Consider this me "getting spoiled" for the 
first time♡
choice_data_list: ...Got it! Let's go have some fun, then!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"That's the spirit~♪ So, where are we 
heading?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What came to mind for now was—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great♪ Let's have a blast with our 
first karaoke trip!

text_block_list.name: Karaoke Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting~ Here's the Special 
Honey Toast, Love Heart Deluxe edition~

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! Amazing! It's just as cute as it 
was on Umastagram~♪
choice_data_list:
Heart really pops in this shot (and that's 
a lot of food...)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Totally! It's so adorable, I don't 
even know where to take the first bite~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll slice it up, so put some 
songs in the queue for us, Trainer-kun! 
Duets only, okay?
choice_data_list: Being limited to a duet is tough…!?
Being limited to a duet is tough, huh…!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:

songs in the queue for us, Trainer-chan! 
Duets only, okay?
choice_data_list: Being limited to a duet is tough…!?
Being limited to a duet is tough, huh…!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~? There are plenty! If you can't think 
of one, let's just go with the classic 
"Umapyoi Densetsu" for now♪
choice_data_list:
That's way too difficult to make into a 
staple routine...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Leave that to me! I'll give Trainer-kun a 
proper lesson♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Leave that to me! I'll give Trainer-chan 
a proper lesson♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Loves Only You and I spent a 
wonderful time together right from the 
start of the new year—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Sounds wonderful♪ Let's enjoy our first 
time at an arcade♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? There sure are a lot of people over 
there.
choice_data_list:
Looks like something straight out of a 
fighting game.

Looks like something straight out of a 
fighting game, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Loud Fighting Gamer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoaaa! Is this really all the 
fighting gamers in this town got!? Man, 
you guys aren't giving me any challenge at 
all!

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Her attitude and her voice might be 
loud, but her skill is the real deal...! 
23 consecutive wins now...! She's 
strong...!

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer B
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe even "Green Tea Tatsu" was 
taken down...! At this rate, the peace of 
this arcade is doomed...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-kun. Could you hold onto my 
jacket for me?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer-chan. Could you hold onto my 
jacket for me?”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I can't overlook this. The selling point 
of this arcade is its wide appeal, from 
casual players to hardcore gamers."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
We can't let a few bad-mannered tryhards 
ruin the balance for everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Loud Fighting Gamer
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well now?! An Umamusume 
student is going to be my opponent?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to our match. If I 
win, no more BM-ing, okay? Let's just have 
good, clean fun♪

text_block_list.name: Loud Fighting Gamer
text_block_list.text:
Fine by meee! If you think you can win, 
that isss!! Looking forward to ittt!!

text_block_list.name: Game Audio
text_block_list.text: 『――K.O. PLAYER 2 WIN! PERFECT!!』

text_block_list.name: Loud Fighting Gamer
text_block_list.text: Ah, a-ah...? Wh... wha-?? I... lost...!?

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer A
text_block_list.text:
No way, her neutral game and wake-up 
pressure are way too good... Who in the 
world is that girl...?!

text_block_list.name: Regular Customer B
text_block_list.text:
"To think she'd shut them down so 
completely...! Her read was terrifyingly 
accurate...!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the match♪ Make sure to keep 
your promise, okay? ♡

text_block_list.name: Quiet Fighting Gamer
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'm sorry... I'll make sure to 
enjoy playing...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Was I being a bit too pushy...? Now that 
it's over, I'm starting to feel 
embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I already knew Loves Only You was a 
fighting game beast from watching her 
streams so many times. Seeing it in 
person, though, I was completely 
overwhelmed by her skill...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Really? ...Well, if Trainer-kun says so, 
it's fine♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Really? ...Well, if Trainer-chan says so, 
it's fine♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's cheer up and play a game 
I can do together with Trainer-kun this 
time♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I spent a fun time at the 
arcade with Loves Only You—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Sounds lovely♪ In that case, as long as 
we're here—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. This is so Luv too...!
choice_data_list: Um, Loves... Isn't it about time...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since we arrived at the clothing 
store, I'd been doing nothing but trying 
on one outfit after another picked out by 
Loves Only You...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, wait! Just one more outfit! Just 
one!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:

super great on you, Trainer-kun! I know 
it'll look totally lovey! Pleeeease!
